item.title: On the Porch: Theo Nollert – Leading on Policy
item.description: This Week: Theo Nollert is the Policy Director at Carolina Forward, a North Carolina think tank, and is currently serving his first term as a member of the Chapel Hill Town Council. Before joining Carolina Forward, he ran the North Carolina Democratic Party's 2024 campus turnout program and was the president of the Graduate and Professional Student Government at UNC.
